title: The Child Who Picked a Grandparent

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — RELATIONSHIPS, SINGLEHOOD AND FAMILY (FAM2-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Couples of every kind, courting, quarrels, separations without blame, widowhood and second loves, happily single and childfree villagers, single parents, grandparents, siblings, chosen and extended families, and affection that isn't romantic. Nobody has to love, marry or have children, everyone may say no to affection, and a player's choice never obliges a villager to anything.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an elder and a child aged 5-11 who are not related)

collection.description: A child has decided an unrelated elder is now their grandparent: go along with it, or gently say no.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) has decided that (subject), an elder who lives alone near the stream, is now (friend.his/her) grandparent. (subject) is not related to (friend) in any way. Nobody asked (subject). (friend) has simply started turning up every afternoon, sitting on (subject.his/her) step and calling (subject.him/her) "Grandpa" or "Grandma."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "I'm not really your grandparent," says (subject) gently. "But you can visit me whenever you like. What would you like to call me instead?" (friend) thinks hard. "Friend?" "Friend it is," says (subject). (friend) visits every afternoon anyway. (friend.He/she) calls (subject.him/her) "Friend" like it's a title. (subject) rather likes it.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) is startled, then amused, then rather touched. "Alright," (subject.he/she) says. "But grandchildren have to help carry water." (friend) carries water. (subject) teaches (friend.him/her) to whittle. The child's own family thinks it's lovely. (subject) has never had grandchildren. (subject.He/she) has one now, apparently.
